hlni.insight: The specific content of a degree (B.Com vs BBA) is institution-dependent and frequently overlaps; module comparison is the only accurate way to assess academic fit.
hlni.audienceGap: Students assume the titles B.Com and BBA represent mutually exclusive career paths or skill sets.
hlni.viewerChange: The student shifts from relying on general stereotypes to performing a practical audit of actual course modules before applying.
hlni.support: Educational curricula are not standardized by degree title; institutional autonomy means module lists vary. Comparing specific assignment tasks provides verifiable evidence of course focus.
hlni.payoff: Demonstrates that the 'correct' choice is found in the content details, not the degree name, empowering the student to make an informed decision.

reelTitle: B.Com vs BBA: Beyond the Stereotypes
creativeAngle: Informative comparison using a physical syllabus audit method
objective: Teach students to compare actual module content rather than relying on degree labels
targetAudience: +2 students seeking academic depth and well-supported course and career decisions

shots.name: The Desk Audit
shots.visual: Student sits at a desk with two printed course outlines, highlighting lines with a pen.
shots.dialogue: Everyone says B.Com is for accounting and BBA is just management. But the labels are hiding the real story.
shots.cameraPerformance: Close-up on the documents, tracking the highlighter.

shots.name: The Module Compare
shots.visual: Student overlays the two sheets, pointing to specific module titles like 'Financial Analysis' in both.
shots.dialogue: Look at the actual modules. You might find core accounting in a BBA, or strategy in a B.Com. Don't pick the title; pick the specific skills you need to practice.

shots.name: The Final Takeaway
shots.visual: Student looks up from the desk, smiling confidently at the camera.
shots.dialogue: Syllabuses vary by university. Map out the tasks, compare the core subjects, and see which actually fits your interests.
shots.onscreenText: Check the syllabus, not just the name.

productionNotes.editing: Steady cuts between paper and student

creativeSummary.keyCreativeIdea: Shifting the student's perspective from choosing a degree title to auditing actual modules to find a personal fit.
